bio: This trendy, urban restaurant and bar is located in the middle of a residential area in Kreis 5 (Zürich's fifth district). The atmosphere is lively and bustling, and in light of their interesting concept, it comes as no surprise that the place is well frequented: they serve tasty modern European cuisine with dishes in starter-sized portions (four is a good number to order). Mouthwatering options include the likes of veal shank ragout with mashed potatoes, confit garlic and Trevisano. Alternatively, there is a five-course set menu – available in omnivore and vegetarian versions. Good wine list and cocktail selection....
